decisions.rationale: The complete demonstrative points to the conception/motivation detail being discussed. The copular introduction is English support.
The complete technical noun directly attests motivation in the opening classification.
The complete expression directly attests particular feature and owns that full noun phrase without the article.
The full example idiom supplies for example. Its unrelated mined present-life gloss is not treated as HGM evidence; complete reference and the current illustration support this function.

The full Tibetan proper name has Devadatta in its glossary, not John. GMR uses John for the intended target in this local illustration, repeated in C05:350/C16:871; TCS02:72 English commentary uses Devadatta. Keep this contextual anglicization provisional, not a canonical name gloss.
The complete exclusivity expression directly attests only and limits the intended target; want to is the English presentation of the intention, not an extra source desire noun.
First BSAD owns kill in the intended John act, distinct from actual mistaken killing and the later general intention.
SNYAM directly attests think to yourself and introduces the first quoted thought. Bound/supporting NAS is left outside rather than given the later Then.

The complete begin-undertaking construction is rendered undertake the deed. BRTSAMS PA has both deed and beginning material, but splitting it as an independent deed solely from a mined equivalent would conceal the source construction; keep the actual full phrase.

The complete Tibetan name corresponds locally to Joe as the misidentified person. The mined HGM John under MCHOD SBYIN is counterevidence to naive lookup, not authority over this source. Reference Yajñadatta and TCS02 English Yajana remain separate; the second English Joe is an explicit anaphoric repetition and stays unbanked.
NOR directly supports mistake in the misidentification clause; unrelated wealth senses do not apply. For John supplies the mistaken comparison target and is not a fresh LHAS BYIN source name.
Second BSAD supplies the actual kill of Joe. It is not assigned the earlier intended kill John.

The full technical stage has literal actual- commission among its glossary forms. Preserve the internal hyphen-space exactly: physical bytes have actual- CRLF commission and normalized source has this space. No silent correction to closed actual-commission is made.

The full inflected negative-existence predicate supplies there is no actual-commission stage. Its causal final-s remains attached; later so we can see expresses the larger inference and is not split from PAS. SDIG wrong-deed qualification has no secure separate English exponent here.

The complete case-setting construction directly corresponds to In this sort of case, supported by the exact DE LTA BU wording and local LA relation. It is one construction, not independent supplied In/this atoms.
First source conception owns the specific-case conception; you have is explicit English explanatory support.
The whole attested adjectival expression directly supports unmistaken, required for the specific-target actual-commission stage. No internal positive English stem is split.
First DGOS has the necessity expressed as must be before the adjective. This is distinct from the later negated need predicate; the complete modal realization is kept with its own occurrence.
Second SBYOR BA directly has undertake, here in the general-motivation condition. The deed and on the other hand expand the English presentation, not extra source words.
The whole indefinite expression directly attests anyone. I happen to meet expands its unrestricted encountered-person sense; no separate meet verb is invented from leftover BYUNG syllables.
This separate GSOD owns kill in the general intention, not either specific-target BSAD occurrence.
The complete second thought form owns think to yourself introducing the general intention. The quoted I will is English prospective support.
Second complete KUN SLONG owns the general motivation in the condition.
SPYI directly attests general. Kind of and some are the English nominal expansion, outside the head.
Second source conception owns the final recap conception; detail of the is supplied explanatory presentation.
The complete adjectival expression owns the second unmistaken. It remains inside the property whose necessity is negated; it does not become mistaken by moving MI onto this word.
MI negates the need predicate, realized by not after need. This is distinct from the MA internal to unmistaken; keep both negative scopes.
Second DGOS directly attests need, negated by MI. Be complete is the English recap of meeting the detail, not an exponent of later CI RIGS PAR.

TSHUL has method/way and principle reference material. In this concluding application the contextual nominal point refers to the explained rule; do not relabel that contextual choice as a literal HGM point gloss.
The second demonstrative owns this before point in the conclusion, distinct from opening This.
LHAG MA directly attests other, denoting the remaining nine action types.
DGU directly attests nine, the remainder after killing.
This concluding YANG adds the other nine, rendered as well. The earlier YANG with anyone is indefinite support, not reused here.

The complete injunctive construction is rendered should understand. SHES PAR BYA directly supports understand and the reference explicitly should be understood; You is supplied. CI RIGS PAR as appropriate remains outside and is not given the earlier be complete.

omissions.tib: opening la; nas after snyam and nor; na after brtsams pa and bsad; du after mchod sbyin
omissions.english: is; Suppose; that you; want to; Then; for John; and; second Joe
omissions.reason: Conditional/example and comparison syntax is distributed across GMR’s explicit narrative. The one source LHAS BYIN owns intended John; one MCHOD SBYIN owns the first Joe at identification. Later for John and kill Joe make those referents explicit again, without another source name to bank. No speculative name reuse or standalone DU/for John is introduced.

omissions.tib: bound genitive after dngos gzhi; sdig; shing; sbyor ba'i dus su; first yang; la zhugs pa yod na
omissions.english: stage; so we can see that, for this stage; If on the other hand; the deed; with some; if; I happen to meet
omissions.reason: Wrong-deed qualification, inference, time/conditional frame and entering a general motivation are rendered through expanded and redistributed English clauses. No exclusive if or with atom is claimed for a different source condition; the direct lexical heads retain their local spans. No absent wrong-deed null is inferred merely from this paraphrase.

omissions.tib: so after second dgos; ni; la after dgu; ci rigs par; bound terminal apostrophe-o
omissions.english: then this detail of; having to be; be complete; applies to; You; that
omissions.reason: The recap of satisfying the conception detail and the final applies-to explanation are distributed. CI RIGS PAR means as appropriate in reference material; its mined complete you should understand crosses the prior sentence and is rejected as correspondence evidence. Do not move be complete from the negated need clause to this later qualifier or invent lexical exponents for terminal particles.
